NYI.head: NY Islanders should have the upper hand
NYI.body: NY Islanders has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Vancouver’s way back in is a power play that gets going.

VAN.head: Vancouver faces a real test
VAN.body: NY Islanders has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Vancouver’s best way through is a power play that gets going.
